name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral-Grip Shoulder Press
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet planted flat and your core braced.
Hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder with palms facing each other and elbows beneath your wrists.
Press both dumbbells straight overhead with the handles parallel until your arms straighten.
Lower the dumbbells slowly under control back to shoulder height.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical during the press.
Keep your ribs tucked down instead of arching your lower back.
